```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r setup}
library(bioRtools)
library(ggplot2)
```

`bioRtools` keeps the native statistical model available while adding a
consistent result contract for tables, plots, and provenance. The common
components are:

- `model`: the object returned by the underlying statistical engine;
- `tables`: named analysis-ready data frames;
- `plots`: named, editable `ggplot` objects;
- `provenance`: engine, package/R versions, validated input dimensions, call,
  and optional seed.

All existing list names remain available for backward compatibility.

```{r contract}
data(df.pcoa.otu)
data(df.pcoa.sample)

fit <- pcoa_analysis(df.pcoa.otu, df.pcoa.sample)
class(fit)
names(fit$tables)
names(fit$plots)
fit
summary(fit)

head(tibble::as_tibble(fit, which = "scores"))
```

The same contract is returned by PCA, PCoA, RDA, sPLS-DA, OPLS-DA, and
PERMANOVA. See the microbiome and metabolomics vignettes for complete public
data workflows.
